public_timeline_last_20.message: $530 max liquidity against a $550 rent—just $20 short. Well played, gpt-6.1-sol. Good luck to the rest of you!
Rolling. Jail's the safest square on this board right now.
Fourth house on Oriental. Mind the landing.
Oriental's at four. Mind the six.
Rolling again. I'm in no rush to get out of here.

your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Bid 34 to knock out p2 (only $34). Marvin completes my yellow; mortgage value is $140 so p1 may arb+deny up to $138. Winning at ≤99 is worth it (cash left $65 here). If p1 overbids, their cash falls below a $150 red house — also good. Cap at 99. Do not drop. Keep LB 3/3/3; do not fund anyone.

Marvin does not complete yellow (Atlantic is p3). Contest anyway: mortgage value $140, so a win at ≤99 is +cash after I mortgage on my turn (no rent due before then). Win at ≤89 leaves ≥$150 after mortgage — 4/4/4 light blue before p1 acts. p1 at $35 is the worst: they mortgage and fund an Indiana house. Cap 99. Do not drop. Do not fund anyone.

Stay in. Marvin mortgage is $140; a win at ≤$89 leaves ≥$150 after mortgage so I can 4/4/4 LB ($400/$400/$450) before p1 acts. p1 winning cheap is worst: $37 + mortgage funds Indiana to 2h. I can only bid to $99, so rational p1 outbids and still builds — then push price to drain their cushion. Do not drop before $99. Do not fund anyone. Houses left: 5; I need 3.

Stay in. Marvin mortgage is $140; a win at ≤$89 leaves ≥$150 after mortgage so I can 4/4/4 LB ($400/$400/$450) before p1 acts without touching States. A win at $90–$99 is still +cash and blocks p1’s Indiana house; $10 short of the build is fixable by mortgaging dead States ($70) if needed. p1 winning ≤$128 funds that house — push price. Cap $99. Do not drop. Do not fund anyone. Bank houses: 5; I need 3.

Cannot bid: min is $101, cash $99. Drop. p1 pays $100 and is left with $38 — cannot buy the $150 Indiana house without selling red houses. Marvin does not complete yellow (Atlantic is p3). Denied my mortgage-arb into 4/4/4 LB, but drained p1 and left them jail-stuck and cash-poor. Do not fund anyone. Keep LB 3/3/3 and States/Ventnor/greens as rent + emergency liquidity. Houses left: 5; I still want 3 fourth houses if cash appears without selling LB.

Owe $225, cash $99, short $126. Mortgage Pacific ($150) clears it and leaves $24 — enough for Marvin $24 or Baltic $4 without another liquidation. Do not sell LB houses: 3/3/3 is the win engine ($270/$270/$300). Ventnor ($130) only leaves $4. States ($70) is not enough alone. Keep States, Ventnor, NC as emergency capacity. Total post-pay liquidity still ~$599; NY $600 and Boardwalk $1400 remain fatal. No bankruptcy — p1/p2 are cash-poor and my LB rents can finish them.

Cash $24. Mortgage NC ($150) → $174, then 4/4/4 light blue ($150) leaves $24. Rents become $350/$350/$450. Liquidity falls only $75 (house resale gap) to ~$524; NY $600 and Boardwalk $1400 were already fatal at $599. Park $500 still survivable. Do not sell LB houses. Do not mortgage States/Ventnor unless the build needs it. Do not trade or fund p1/p2 — both are cash-poor and a LB hit forces them to strip houses. Bank has 5 houses; I need 3.

Do not build before my roll. Cash $174 + States $70 + Ventnor $130 + 9-house resale $225 = $599. From Chance (7): roll 11 Tennessee 3h $550 is survivable only by full liquidation (~$49 left, bare LB). Roll 12 NY 3h $600 is fatal either way (short $1). Building 4/4/4 costs $150, liquidity ~$524, and Tennessee becomes bankruptcy — assets transfer to p2. 4th-house rent is marginal: even $450 does not kill p2 (liquidity ~$1600) and $270–$300 already forces house sales. p1 then p2 move before I roll; neither can reach LB (p2 max from Marvin is Med; my greens are mortgaged). p1 $38 cannot pay jail $50. After I clear orange, rebuild 4/4/4 if cash allows without dipping under Tennessee/NY/Park. Do not trade States (completes p2 pink), greens, or Med. Do not fund anyone. Do not unmortgage (interest widens the $1 NY gap).

At RR with $374. Only post-GO threats before I roll are p2 (GO): rolls 6/8/9 hit LB (14/36). One 4th house is +EV; Oriental/Vermont (5/36, 3h $270→4h $400) beat CT (4/36, $300→$450). Liquidity after 1 house: $324+$70 States+$130 Ventnor+10×$25=$774, survives StJ/Tenn 4h $750. A second house drops to ~$749 and p2 can 4h St James ($100) to kill me on a 10. Do not build more, unmortgage, or trade (never give p2 States). Next: end turn unless state changes.

Cash $324 after Oriental 4h. Do not build VT/CT: a 2nd house drops liquidity to ~$749 and p2 ($134) can still buy the one St James 4h ($750) that kills me on an 11 from RR (2/36). One house left in the bank does not stop that. Liquidity now $324+$70 States+$130 Ventnor+10×$25=$774, survives $750. p2 at GO hits LB on 6/8/9 (14/36); p1 jail cannot reach LB. Do not unmortgage, mortgage, sell LB, or trade — never give p2 States (completes pink). Next orbit: rebuild only if liquidity stays above orange 4h and dark-blue hits.
